# /api/v1 reads: run objects, GET runs, GET run, GET workspaces

## What to build

The read half of graph-manager's automation API (`apps/graph-manager/src/server`), so a client with a token can follow runs. It adds a **run object** mapping in a new `src/server/v1-runs.ts` and three routes in `src/server/routes/v1.ts`:

- `GET /api/v1/runs/:id` (scope `runs:read`) → the run object, or `404 {"error":"unknown run"}`.
- `GET /api/v1/runs?workspace=&status=&ref=` (scope `runs:read`) → `{ runs: RunObject[] }`, newest first; every given filter must match (AND).
- `GET /api/v1/workspaces` (scope `workspaces:read`) → `{ workspaces: [{ id, forge, owner, repo, defaultProvider? }] }`.

The run object (exact JSON shape from the spec):
```json
{ "runId": "gm-…", "workspace": "<ws id>", "status": "planning|needs-info|awaiting-approval|running|applied|done|failed|aborted",
  "refs": [{"ref":"KAN-41","url":"…"}], "questions": [{"ref":"KAN-42","questions":["…"]}], "dropped": ["KAN-42"],
  "spec": "docs/prd/<name>.md", "tasksDir": ".agents/tasks/<name>", "viewUrl": "/runs/…", "pr": {"url":"…"},
  "error": "failure summary, only when failed", "createdAt": "…", "updatedAt": "…" }
```
Suites are not part of v1 (left out of lists; `GET /api/v1/runs/<suite id>` → 404). Later slices reuse `findRun` and `toRunObject` for the write routes, so export them.

### What is already in the code (dependencies)

- **API tokens** (`src/server/tokens.ts`, `src/server/auth.ts`): `API_SCOPES`, `type ApiScope`, `requireScope(scope)` (a Fastify `preHandler` answering `403 {"error":"missing scope <s>"}`), `apiAuthOf(req)`. Bearer tokens (`Authorization: Bearer gmt_…`) and the cookie session both work on `/api/v1/*`. `src/server/routes/v1.ts` exists with `export async function v1Routes(app, ctx)` holding `GET /api/v1/ping`, registered in `src/server/app.ts`. Tests create a token with `POST /api/tokens {name, scopes}` (cookie) → `201 {id, token, …}`.
- **Engine state** (`packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts`, re-exported from `graph-execution/api`): `runStatusSchema` includes `"planning" | "needs-info" | "awaiting-approval"` besides `running | applied | done | failed | aborted`. `stateSchema` has an optional `plan: { contentPath: string, refs: {ref: string, url?: string, title?: string}[], gate: boolean, name?: string, attempts: number, questions: {ref?: string, questions: string[]}[], dropped: string[], feedback: string[] }`. `specPath`, `tasksDir` and `hashes` are **optional** (absent while planning); once planned they hold the repo paths `<repo>/docs/prd/<name>.md` and `<repo>/.agents/tasks/<name>`, but until the run is applied those files exist only on the integration branch `graph/<runId>` (its worktree `<runDir>/worktrees/integration`), not in the checkout. `plan` also has `error?: string` (the last planning error when the run failed in planning). `graph-execution/api` exports `planSpecRel(name)` (`docs/prd/<name>.md`) and `planTasksRel(name)` (`.agents/tasks/<name>`), and `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` (4) / `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` (5); the run process exits at `needs-info` and `awaiting-approval`. The engine slice already made graph-manager's readers of `specPath`/`tasksDir` (`runs.ts`, `pr.ts`, `routes/internal.ts`) cope with `undefined`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` — `RunSummary` (21–44), `viewUrlOf` (109–110), `livePage` (160–164), `readState`/`hostState` (167–184, private: reads `state.json` with `stateSchema.safeParse`), `failureOf` (209–231, the short failure label), `summarize` (243–277, private), `listWorkspaceRuns` (285–293), `listRuns` (296–300, newest first via `newestFirst` 280–282), `runDetail` (499–529, heavy: git calls; do NOT use it for lists), `runDirOf` (532).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts` (lines 31–54) — `CachedView.summary.abort?: { step, message }`, the run page's failure summary; `readCachedView(dataDir, wsId, runId)` (line 242).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 66–84) — the cookie `GET /api/runs` and `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId` to mirror (prs from `ctx.store.get().prs`, `ctx.config.dataDir`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` (lines 6–17 `Workspace`: `id`, `path`, `rel`, `forge`, `fullPath`; 33 `listWorkspaces(root)`; 57 `resolveWorkspace(root, id)`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` — `runDefaults: Record<wsId, { provider, tasksDir, spec, options }>` (lines 29–34); `prs: Record<"<ws>/<runId>", { url, number, branch, base?, forge, createdAt }>` (20–25).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.ts` and `src/server/auth.ts` (`requireScope`) — where the routes go and the guard.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.test.ts` (lines 56–78 `writeRun`) — how a test writes a run folder with a `stateSchema.parse(...)`-checked `state.json` without running the engine.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.test.ts` (lines 20–47) — the same, plus `appWithLogin()` and a workspace made with `git init` under `config.workspacesDir/github/octo/hello` (workspace id `github~octo~hello`).

## Patterns to follow

**Route with a scope (routes/v1.ts):**
```ts
app.get<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/v1/runs/:id", { preHandler: requireScope("runs:read") }, async (req, reply) => {
  if (!isRunId(req.params.id)) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown run" });
  const found = await findRun(ctx, req.params.id);
  if (!found) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown run" });
  return toRunObject(ctx, found);
});
```

**Error handling:** `reply.code(n).send({ error: "…" })`; zod parse errors become `400 {"error":"<path>: <message>"}` via app.ts's error handler (lines 105–122), so validate the query with `querySchema.parse(req.query)`.

**Reading state:** mirror `runs.ts` `readState` (`stateSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(runDir, "state.json"), "utf8")))`, undefined on any error).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `export const detailUrlOf = (workspaceId: string, runId: string): string => "/runs/" + encodeURIComponent(workspaceId) + "/" + encodeURIComponent(runId);` — graph-manager's run detail page (the SPA route `/runs/:ws/:runId`, which embeds the live page). **Decision**: v1's `viewUrl` is this detail page, not `viewUrlOf` (the run-page proxy only answers while the run's process is up, and a planned run spends days without one).
  - `export async function runSummaryOf(ws: Workspace, runId: string, extras: SummaryExtras = {}): Promise<{ summary: RunSummary; state?: RunState } | undefined>`: `scan(ws.path)`, find the entry, `undefined` for a missing id or a suite; else `readState` + `summarize(ws, entry, state, extras)`.
  - `export async function readRunStateOf(ws: Workspace, runId: string): Promise<RunState | undefined>` (thin export of `readState(ws, runDirOf(ws, runId))`).
- **GOTCHA**: `specPath`/`tasksDir` are optional in `stateSchema`; the engine slice already guarded `hostState`, `buildGraph`, `runDetail` and `pr.ts`. If `npm run typecheck` still reports one of them, guard it (`state.tasksDir ? … : undefined`).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/v1-runs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
```ts
export const V1_STATUSES = ["planning", "needs-info", "awaiting-approval", "running", "applied", "done", "failed", "aborted"] as const;
export type V1Status = (typeof V1_STATUSES)[number];
export interface RunRef { ref: string; url?: string; title?: string }
export interface RunObject {
  runId: string; workspace: string; status: V1Status;
  refs: RunRef[]; questions: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[]; dropped: string[];
  spec?: string; tasksDir?: string; viewUrl: string; pr?: { url: string; number: number };
  error?: string; createdAt?: string; updatedAt?: string;
}
export interface FoundRun { ws: Workspace; runId: string; summary: RunSummary; state?: RunState }
/** The run with this id in any workspace (first match; run ids carry a timestamp and random hex). Suites: undefined. */
export async function findRun(ctx: AppContext, runId: string): Promise<FoundRun | undefined>
/** Every run (no suites) of one workspace or of all, newest first. */
export async function listFoundRuns(ctx: AppContext, ws?: Workspace): Promise<FoundRun[]>
export async function toRunObject(ctx: AppContext, run: FoundRun): Promise<RunObject>
```
  - `findRun`: `for (const ws of await listWorkspaces(ctx.config.workspacesDir)) if (existsSync(runDirOf(ws, runId))) { const r = await runSummaryOf(ws, runId, { prs: ctx.store.get().prs, dataDir: ctx.config.dataDir }); if (r) return { ws, runId, ...r }; }`.
  - `listFoundRuns`: for each workspace `listWorkspaceRuns(ws, prs, dataDir)`, keep `type === "run"`, read each state with `readRunStateOf`, sort newest first (`createdAt` desc, then id desc — mirror `newestFirst` in runs.ts 280–282).
  - **Status mapping** (`v1StatusOf(summary, state)`): take `summary.status` (it already turns a dead `running` into `interrupted`). `interrupted` → `failed` (decision: the spec's enum has no `interrupted`; such a run can be resumed, which v1 allows for `failed`). `unknown` or any other value not in `V1_STATUSES` → `failed`. Otherwise the value.
  - `refs`: `state.plan?.refs ?? []`. (The start slice later adds a store registry `apiRuns` and makes this read its refs first; nothing to do for it here.)
  - `questions`: `state.plan?.questions ?? []`; `dropped`: `state.plan?.dropped ?? []`.
  - `spec` / `tasksDir`: when `state.plan?.name` → `planSpecRel(name)` and `planTasksRel(name)` (from `graph-execution/api`; never derive them from `state.specPath`, whose file is not in the checkout before apply); else, when `state.specPath` / `state.tasksDir` are set, their path relative to `ws.path` with `/` separators (`path.relative(ws.path, p).split(path.sep).join("/")`), and only when that relative path does not start with `..` (else leave the field out).
  - `viewUrl`: `detailUrlOf(ws.id, runId)`.
  - `pr`: from `ctx.store.get().prs[ws.id + "/" + runId]` → `{ url, number }`.
  - `error` (only when the mapped status is `failed`): read `readCachedView(ctx.config.dataDir, ws.id, runId)`; if `state.plan?.error` → `"planning failed: " + state.plan.error`; else if `view?.summary?.abort` → `abort.step + " failed: " + abort.message`; else `summary.failure` (the run page's short label, e.g. `task 3 failed`); for an `interrupted` run `"interrupted: the run's process is gone"`; fallback `"failed"`.
  - `createdAt`: `state?.createdAt ?? summary.createdAt`; `updatedAt`: `(await stat(path.join(runDirOf(ws, runId), "state.json"))).mtime.toISOString()`, left out when the stat fails.
  - Omit optional keys whose value is undefined (no `"spec": null`).
- **IMPORTS**: `existsSync` (`node:fs`), `stat` (`node:fs/promises`), `path`; `planSpecRel, planTasksRel, type RunState` from `graph-execution/api`; `detailUrlOf, listWorkspaceRuns, readRunStateOf, runDirOf, runSummaryOf, type RunSummary` from `./runs.js`; `readCachedView` from `./viewcache.js`; `listWorkspaces, type Workspace` from `./workspaces.js`; `type AppContext` from `./app.js`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `GET /api/v1/runs/:id` (`runs:read`) as in the pattern.
  - `GET /api/v1/runs` (`runs:read`): query `z.object({ workspace: z.string().min(1).optional(), status: z.enum(V1_STATUSES).optional(), ref: z.string().min(1).optional() })`. An unknown `workspace` → `404 {"error":"unknown workspace"}` (use `resolveWorkspace` and check `existsSync(ws.path)`). Build objects with `toRunObject` for `listFoundRuns(ctx, ws)`, then filter: `status` equals the mapped status; `ref` matches when `refs.some((r) => r.ref === ref)`. Return `{ runs }` (already newest first).
  - `GET /api/v1/workspaces` (`workspaces:read`): `listWorkspaces(ctx.config.workspacesDir)` → `{ id: ws.id, forge: ws.forge, owner, repo, ...(defaultProvider ? { defaultProvider } : {}) }` where `owner` is every segment of `ws.fullPath` but the last joined with `/` (GitLab groups: `grp/sub`), `repo` the last segment, `defaultProvider = ctx.store.get().runDefaults[ws.id]?.provider`.
- **GOTCHA**: register these with `{ preHandler: requireScope(...) }` (the options object is the second argument). Route paths must not clash with the cookie `/api/runs/...` routes (they don't: different prefix).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.test.ts`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** with `appWithLogin()`; a helper `token(scopes)` that POSTs `/api/tokens` with the cookie and returns the plain token; a helper `writeRun(wsDir, runId, state)` that writes `.graph-execution/<runId>/state.json` with `stateSchema.parse({...})` (mirror `routes/pr.test.ts` 56–78; workspace = `git init -q -b main` in `config.workspacesDir/github/octo/hello`, id `github~octo~hello`; a second workspace `gitlab/grp/sub/proj` → id `gitlab~grp~sub~proj`). Cases:
  - A run with `status: "awaiting-approval"` and `plan: { contentPath: "x", refs: [{ref:"A",url:"https://t/A"},{ref:"B"}], gate: true, name: "hello-feature", attempts: 1, questions: [{ref:"B",questions:["Which color?"]}], dropped: ["B"], feedback: [] }` (no specPath/tasksDir/hashes) → `GET /api/v1/runs/<id>` with a `runs:read` bearer returns exactly `{ runId, workspace: "github~octo~hello", status: "awaiting-approval", refs: [...], questions: [...], dropped: ["B"], spec: "docs/prd/hello-feature.md", tasksDir: ".agents/tasks/hello-feature", viewUrl: "/runs/github~octo~hello/<id>", createdAt, updatedAt }` (`updatedAt`: `expect.any(String)`).
  - A `failed` run with `plan.error: "bad tasks"` → `error: "planning failed: bad tasks"`. A `failed` run with a failed task in `state.tasks` → `error: "task 1 failed"`; an `applied` run has no `error` key; a `prs` store entry for it (`store.update`) → `pr: { url, number }`.
  - A run whose state says `running` with no live process → `status: "failed"`, `error` starts with `interrupted`.
  - `GET /api/v1/runs` lists newest first (by `createdAt`); `?status=failed`, `?ref=A`, `?workspace=gitlab~grp~sub~proj` filter; combined filters AND; `?status=bogus` → 400; unknown workspace → 404.
  - A suite folder is not listed — skip this case if building a valid suite state (`packages/graph-execution/src/suite/state.ts` `suiteStateSchema`) is more than a few lines.
  - `GET /api/v1/runs/gm-20990101-000000-ffff` → 404 `unknown run`.
  - `GET /api/v1/workspaces` with a `workspaces:read` token → both workspaces with `owner`/`repo` (`octo`/`hello`, `grp/sub`/`proj`); after `store.update((d) => { d.runDefaults["github~octo~hello"] = { provider: "fake", tasksDir: "t", spec: "s.md", options: {} }; })` it has `defaultProvider: "fake"`.
  - Scopes: a `workspaces:read`-only token on `/api/v1/runs` → 403 `{"error":"missing scope runs:read"}`; a `runs:read`-only token on `/api/v1/workspaces` → 403 `missing scope workspaces:read`; no credentials → 401; the cookie → 200.
- **PATTERN**: `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.test.ts`, `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.test.ts`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/v1/runs/:id` → the run object with exactly the spec's keys (optional ones left out when absent), `viewUrl` = `/runs/<ws>/<runId>`, `error` only for `failed`.
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/runs?workspace=&status=&ref=` → `{runs}` newest first, filters ANDed; `?ref=A` returns only runs whose refs contain `A`; bad status → 400; unknown workspace → 404.
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/workspaces` → `{workspaces:[{id, forge, owner, repo, defaultProvider?}]}`.
- [ ] Scope `runs:read` guards the run reads, `workspaces:read` the workspace list (403 `missing scope <s>`); no credentials → 401.
- [ ] Planned runs without `specPath`/`tasksDir` don't break `GET /api/runs`, `GET /api/runs/:ws/:runId` or the v1 routes.
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.test.ts src/server/routes/runs.test.ts src/server/runs.test.ts
npm test -w graph-manager
```
